\parbox{\linewidth}{\scriptsize Gains are P(feature $|$ passed stage)/P(feature $|$ entered stage), year-standardised over 2024-26; total = accepted/all; 95\% CIs from a paper bootstrap stratified by year (B = 2000). Style density is a mean (words per abstract), its gains are ratios of means. Audit: pre-decision arXiv v1 vs stored title (abstract for F24 and em dash), accepted minus rejected net flips (pseudo-flip Wald 95\% CI); a feature is auditable with $>$= 10 v1-present titles in both arms and if arXiv metadata can carry it (arXiv titles are never ALL-CAPS or U+2011/U+2013-typographic; arXiv abstracts carry TeX dashes). Complete audit: original + enlargement, 2023-26 pre-decision pairs (abstracts: 2024-26 pairs). D$^{*}$: net-flip DiD that would bring the decision gain to 1. Passes gate: auditable, editing-corrected 95\% CI excludes 1 and the identification p survives Holm across the 18 auditable title features at one-sided 0.025 (for F24: tipping point outside the CI). --- = not audited (density measure).}
